entities.summary: Giovan Battista Nani, in French Jean Baptiste Felix Gaspard Nani, was a Venetian ambassador, librarian, archivist, amateur botanist and historian, born into a patrician family. For 25 years (1643–68) Battista was the Republic of Venice's ambassador to France.
